snippet.title: No Man's Sky Beacon Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Expand your planetary empire in No Man's Sky BEACON. Become Overseer of multiple planetary settlements, and discover the townships of the secretive robotic Autophage. Introducing improved settlement balance, more variety of management decisions, building upgrades, infestations, new base parts and more...including the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, a free upgrade for existing Switch players.

Full patch notes available here: https://www.nomanssky.com/beacon-update
